page_title: UDI 0-0 MON | Udinese v Monza 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' A yellow card is awarded to Armando Izzo (Monza).
90+2' A rebound sits up nicely for Patrick Ciurria (Monza) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
90+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alessio Zerbin (Monza), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+2' Valentin Carboni (Monza) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
89' The ball is cleared after Alessio Zerbin (Monza) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Monza win a corner.
88' Substitution. Brenner (Udinese) replaces Florian Thauvin.
86' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
85' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
84' Pedro Pereira (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' Here's the change. Danilo D'Ambrosio leaves the pitch and Armando Izzo (Monza) comes on as a substitute.
81' Michele Di Gregorio is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese). Easy save!
79' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
77' Pedro Pereira (Monza) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
75' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
73' Dany Mota goes off the pitch and Pedro Pereira (Monza) comes on.
73' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
71' Udinese get a corner.
71' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
68' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Jordan Zemura is replaced by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
68' Substitution. Martin Payero is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Udinese).
66' Dany Mota (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
65' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' A pass by Dany Mota (Monza) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
64' Valentin Carboni (Monza) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
61' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio is equal to it and makes an easy save.
60' Walace (Udinese) is penalised.
58' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
57' Substitution. Roberto Pereyra walks off the pitch and Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
57' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Andrea Colpani will be replaced by Valentin Carboni (Monza).
57' The manager makes a subsitution with Alessio Zerbin (Monza) coming on for Samuele Birindelli.
56' A cross from a corner kick by Udinese is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
56' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
55' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
53' Andrea Colpani (Monza) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
53' Monza will take a corner kick.
53' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Monza will take a corner.
50' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) sends a long ball in, but Michele Di Gregorio comfortably gathers the ball.
48' Andrea Colpani (Monza) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Dany Mota (Monza) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luca Caldirola as he is replaced by Andrea Carboni (Monza).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Alessandro Prontera has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45' Poor effort! The corner picks out Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
45' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) will take the corner.

44' A neat pass is well received by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Udinese force their opponents to concede a corner.
44' A cross into the box from Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is cleared.
43' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
42' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) commits a rough foul. Alessandro Prontera stops the game and makes a call.
38' Monza are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

35' A neat pass finds Florian Thauvin (Udinese) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio denies him with a good save.
34' The corner kick from Andrea Colpani (Monza) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Andrea Colpani (Monza). The ball is out of play and Monza manage to earn a corner.
32' Andrea Colpani (Monza) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
32' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle and it's Florian Thauvin (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
30' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Udinese earn a corner.
30' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
29' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
27' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
27' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.
25' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is penalised for holding. Alessandro Prontera signals a set piece.
23' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
21' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
18' Martin Payero (Udinese) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.

15' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
13' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
10' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
9' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Michele Di Gregorio is alert and denies him.
7' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Andrea Colpani (Monza) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) plays a through ball but overhits it.
4' Martin Payero (Udinese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.

3' Udinese slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Alessandro Prontera will officiate today.
